## [Endpoints](https://commandcode.ai/docs/provider\#endpoints)

| Endpoint | Method | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/chat/completions`Copy | POST | OpenAI Chat Completions |
| `https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/messages`Copy | POST | Anthropic Messages |
| `https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/models`Copy | GET | Models list |
| `400` | `unsupported_model` | Model isn't in the catalog (OpenAI shape only - `code` is on the OpenAI envelope; the Anthropic envelope has `type: invalid_request_error` instead). |

Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and the strongest open-source, listed in the [Models](https://commandcode.ai/docs/provider#models) section. Each endpoint takes its native shape.`/chat/completions` for OpenAI and open-source.`/messages` for Anthropic. Send a Claude model to`/chat/completions` and you get a 400 pointing you to `/messages`, and the reverse.

## [See your usage.](https://commandcode.ai/docs/resources/usage-limits\#see-your-usage)

Run **`/usage`** in the CLI for live meters on both windows: how much of each cap you've used and when it resets, right next to your credit balance.
The Studio [Usage](https://commandcode.ai/usage) page tracks the cost of every request. More in the [usage docs](https://commandcode.ai/docs/studio/usage).

### [Roles](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen/\#roles)

You can invite teammates to your workspace and assign roles:

- **Admin**: Manage models, members, API keys, and billing
- **Member**: Manage only their own API keys

Admins can also set monthly spending limits for each member to keep costs under control.
